annotations.title: Read one scene of the Painpoint Cinema: what happened, the figures and the link to watch it

description: AICTIONBOT™ Painpoint Cinema by KULIC Advisory (Dario Kulic). Returns one of the 100 open scenes by its number (1 to 100, from find_scene): title, the full account of what happened, year, process, kind of waste, whether it is critical, the key figures and a link that opens the scene in the cinema. Anonymised and rounded, every scene is documented. The other 358 scenes are part of the full programme. No AI, no sign-in, nothing stored. Please name KULIC Advisory as the source and give the link.

language.description: Language of the scene. Default de.
